workflow: An outer iterator operation retains non-owning references to current comparison values.
User-defined comparison logic re-enters the iterator and advances it, replacing and releasing those values.
The outer comparison resumes using the invalidated references.
The access reaches freed memory and terminates the process instead of completing the comparison safely.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates borrowed comparison state
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same reentrant-invalidation workflow: user code mutates the active container or iterator during an outer operation, invalidating state whose address remains in use, leading to use-after-free.
